item.text: The pager stops when the returned *visible* items are fewer than `pageSize`. Since deleted rows are filtered before the pager sees them, a full storage page containing one active and one deleted record looks “short” and prevents the next page from being fetched. I’ll make continuation depend on the gateway’s `next` cursor and add the invoice case as a regression test.

Fixed invoice pagination so the export follows the gateway’s `next` cursor even when deleted rows make a page appear short. Added a regression case verifying that `i-3` is included after deleted record `i-2`.
